title: PeopleSoft Studio's Component Interface writer replays App Designer's captured saves: every replay test passes
statement: src/test/ciWriter.test.ts rebuilds App Designer's captured saves (HRDMO, PeopleTools 8.62.09) through Studio's Component Interface writer and requires App Designer's rows and counters; every top-level test passed in the recorded run. Evidence about Studio, not PeopleSoft (rule 3); it says nothing about releases not captured. docs/COMPONENT_INTERFACES.md lists the cases.

observations.observation: Run of src/test/ciWriter.test.ts (node:test, TAP): 9 top-level tests, all passed.

testResults.name: a new interface defaulted from its component is App Designer's, item for item, SYNCIDs and names (ci01-ci04)
"No" to defaulting: the key items only, and the name made again leaves PSBCDEL (ci28)
Definition Properties: General, Standard Methods (CLM), Synchronization (ci05-ci10)
Edit Property: a rename keeps the SYNCID; Comment and Read Only (ci11, ci12)
Delete: a property, a key, a collection with everything under it (ci13, ci16, ci19)
Drag: a field takes its buffer number and the next SYNCID; a key; a Long Edit field (ci14, ci15, ci17)
Drag: a scroll, with its child scrolls, push buttons, invisible fields; merged into its collection (ci20-ci23)
Save As: a copy whose every item takes a new SYNCID in the window's order (ci25)
an interface saved unchanged plans nothing
